Name: Fly Nordica
Company description: Nordica is an Estonian airline operating for other airlines, offering charter and PSO traffic. The company is a part of the Nordic Aviation Group, owned 100% by the Republic of Estonia.  The group operates long-term ACMI production for major airlines within Europe and utilizes two separate commercial operating brands: Nordica and Xfly. The group has bases in Tallinn (headquarter), Stockholm, Gällivare, Copenhagen, Aarhus, Vilnius, Lisbon, Hamburg, Munich and Turku. The group offers strategic partnership by providing long-term flight services to other European airlines with our aircraft and crews, thus releasing our customer's resources from the burden of complex in-house production. The group employs more than 600 aviation specialists across Europe.  The company plans to expand  in the coming years by constantly increasing its aircraft fleet. As a milestone of further expansion, the company introduced its first 180-seat Airbus 320 aircraft, and is welcoming other three Airbus A320NEO  in spring 2023 to start operating for a new customer.  The company embraces Nordic values and work culture. We value both, individual and team work.  For more information please visit our homepage www.nordica.ee . The company regularly recruits new aviation specialists in its growth. For open positions feel free to visit our career page jobs.nagroup.ee and join our growth team!

Name: Xfly
Company description: We are Xfly – a leading capacity provider for commercial airlines in Europe. The company provides safe and high-quality flight operations with long-term CPA contracts for ACMI services.  Compared to operating regional aircraft inhouse, our customers reduce their costs by 30-40% through long-term outsourcing. This corresponds to an annual cost saving of up to 3 million euros per aircraft.  Our mission is to link people and regions through efficient and sustainable flights. Built for the new age of commercial aviation and serving as an integral part of the client’s mission, we don’t just operate for other airlines – we keep our promises and deliver their brand. Xfly is a real-life performer with a passion for flying. Xfly is a preferred partner of several major European airlines in operating their European traffic.  The company was established by the state owned Nordic Aviation Group AS back in 2015.  Xfly operates a fleet of 16 aircraft - modern CRJ700/900 and ATR72. We are also in the process of introducing E-Jets.  Outsourcing of regional production enables our customers to maintain efficiency in regional segment. It reduces the complexity of in-house production and gives a greater degree of flexibility and frees resources for maintaining and gaining market share.  Xfly provides customized solutions for capacity needs on medium and long-term contracts, ensuring strong service delivery and perceived quality for customer. The group is a caring employer to over 600 aviation specialists and is headquartered in Tallinn, Estonia. The group has bases in Stockholm (Arlanda), Copenhagen, Turku, Aarhus, Lisbon, Munich and Hamburg.
